query: What caused database requests to become slow and which changes made them fast again?

rows.title: Missing database index
rows.text: Slow PostgreSQL queries were caused by a missing index on the customer_id column. Adding a B-tree index reduced query latency from 900 milliseconds to 40 milliseconds.

rows.title: Report scan optimization
rows.text: The SQL dashboard returned late because a report scanned every row. Adding an index and rewriting the filter improved database query performance.

rows.title: Lock contention resolved
rows.text: Contention for table locks stalled requests to PostgreSQL. Breaking up one long transaction restored fast responses.

rows.title: Backup recovery drill
rows.text: The nightly PostgreSQL backup completed successfully. The recovery drill restored a database copy in a staging instance.

rows.title: Documentation color update
rows.text: The documentation website theme changed from blue to green. The designers made chart labels larger and updated the illustrations.
